formulas.description: Value returned TRUE if Case Account's Support Model is part of Japan or Korea and requires a CSM Assignment for those accounts. Used for exceptions in flow.
formulas.name: formJapanCSMAssignmentModels
formulas.expression: IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'Field TAM (Japan Bypass Triage)', TRUE, IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'Field TAM (Korea Bypass Triage)', TRUE, IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'SC-Exempt (Japan Bypass Triage)', TRUE, IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'SC-Exempt (Korea Bypass Triage)', TRUE, FALSE))))

formulas.description: Value returned TRUE if Case Account's Support Model is part of Japan or Korea. Used for exceptions in flow.
formulas.name: formJapanSupportModels
formulas.expression: IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'Hybrid (Japan Bypass)', TRUE, IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'Partner Supported (SC Japan Bypass)', TRUE, IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'Support Center (Japan Bypass)', TRUE, FALSE)))

formulas.name: formula_EmailOrigin
formulas.expression: IF(TEXT({!IncomingRecord.Origin}) = 'Email', TRUE, IF(TEXT({!IncomingRecord.Origin}) = 'Email-Tan', TRUE, IF(TEXT({!IncomingRecord.Origin}) = 'Email-Tanowner', TRUE, FALSE)))

formulas.name: formula_KoreaSupportModels
formulas.expression: IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'Hybrid - South Korea', TRUE, IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'Partner Supported - South Korea', TRUE, IF( {!IncomingRecord.Support_Model__c} = 'Support Center - South Korea', TRUE, FALSE)))
